rows_audited.rem:though_may_tempted_include: DEC-54 (b): 'for every model (G,X), a map locally modelled on z -> z^p, p != 1, is not an a.e. morphism'. Headline GX.not_isAEMorphismOf_maximalAtlas_of_eventually_eq_pow: G, X universe-polymorphic with only the standing analyticity instances (LocallyConnectedSpace X, T2Space X, IsRigidAction G X, ContinuousConstSMul; DEC-39 weakened), M, N arbitrary (G,X)-manifolds (ChartedSpace + HasGroupoid gxGroupoid, i.e. Riemann surfaces as (G,X)-manifolds, empty singular locus), f = psi o (.)^p o phi near x with phi ANY open partial homeomorphism M -> C centred at x and psi : C -> N ARBITRARY (stronger than 'locally modelled', which takes psi a chart), p != 1 (p = 0 included, also true) => not IsAEMorphismOf for the maximal atlases. That is the ruled reading, at least as strong. The general form not_isAEMorphismOf_of_eventually_eq_pow (any a.e. atlases regular at x and f x) is the strongest true form: dropping regularity at x / f x would be false, since branched coverings with branch locus in the singular set ARE a.e. morphisms (the paper's subject). The proof follows the remark's argument: z^p injective on no neighbourhood of 0 (roots of unity), hence f not locally injective at x, hence x not in Reg(f) (IsRegularOn => IsLocalHomeomorphOn, a genuine consequence of the chart condition), contradicting lem:regf1 (IsAEMorphismOf.regLocusOf_eq). Hypotheses satisfiable (e.g. X = C, M = N = C); none carries the conclusion; definitions IsRegularOn / regLocusOf / IsAEMorphismOf non-trivial (checked l.568-663). zero_notMem_regLocusOf_pow covers '0 notin Reg(z -> z^p)' for any atlases on C. Mark justified under DEC-54 (b); row closed under the ruling, per DEC-27's ruling clause.
